integration_removed.description:
The LANnouncer integration has been removed from __HA_KEEP__ because the LANnouncer Android app is no longer available.

To resolve this issue:
1. Remove the LANnouncer integration from your `configuration.yaml`.
2. Restart the __HA_KEEP__ instance.

After removal, this issue will disappear.
integration_removed.title: LANnouncer integration has been removed
